name: libspatialite

about.summary: Extend the SQLite core to support fully fledged Spatial SQL capabilities
Extend the SQLite core to support fully fledged Spatial SQL capabilities

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "5.1.0"
  build_number: 23
  # gpl gets a higher build number since we want to favor the build where
  # librttopo is included
  build: ${{ build_number + 100 if license_family == "gpl" else build_number }}

package:
  name: libspatialite
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://www.gaia-gis.it/gaia-sins/libspatialite-sources/libspatialite-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 43be2dd349daffe016dd1400c5d11285828c22fea35ca5109f21f3ed50605080
  patches:
    # Patch Win to fix build path
    - if: win
      then: 0001-win_fix_paths.patch
    # Patch configure for OSX to make sure we get dylib, not so
    - if: osx
      then: 0002-osx_fix_lib_ext.patch
    # Skip some tests that fail
    - 0003-skip_tests.patch
    # Guard deprecated nanohttp cleanup for libxml2 2.14 where HTTP may be disabled
    - 0004-guard-nanohttp-cleanup.patch
    # Disable rttopo support when GPL is not allowed
    - if: license_family != "gpl"
      then: 0005-create_vector_coverages-without-rttopo.patch
    - if: win and license_family != "gpl"
      then: 0006-win_fix_lgpl_defines.patch
    # SQLite >= 3.54 refuses ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN rowid; skip the
    # shadowed-rowid checks in check_spatialindex in that case
    - 0007-skip-shadowed-rowid-test-sqlite-3.54.patch
    # check_topoplus picks a vertex by edge id, which depends on the ordering
    # of GEOS overlay output; use the vertex coordinates instead
    - 0008-topoplus-dirty-node-by-coordinates.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build }}
  string: ${{ license_family }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build }}

requirements:
  build:
    - if: linux
      then:
        - autoconf
        - automake
        - libtool
    - if: unix
      then:
        - pkgconf
        - make
        - gnuconfig
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
  host:
    - if: osx
      then: libiconv
    - sqlite
    - geos
    - proj
    - freexl >=2
    - zlib
    - libxml2-devel
    - if: license_family == "gpl"
      then: librttopo
  run:
    - if: osx
      then: libiconv
    - sqlite
    - geos
    - proj
    - freexl >=2
    - zlib
    - libxml2-devel
    - if: license_family == "gpl"
      then: librttopo
  run_exports:
    # No idea.  Staying with minor version pin.
    - ${{ pin_subpackage('libspatialite', upper_bound='x.x') }}

tests:
  - script:
      - python run_test.py
    requirements:
      run:
        - python
    files:
      recipe:
        - run_test.py
  - if: win
    then:
      script:
        - call test-spatialite.bat ${{ license_family }}
      requirements:
        build:
          - ${{ compiler('c') }}
      files:
        recipe:
          - test-spatialite.c
          - test-spatialite.bat

about:
  homepage: https://www.gaia-gis.it/fossil/libspatialite/index
  license: MPL-1.1
  license_file: COPYING
  summary: Extend the SQLite core to support fully fledged Spatial SQL capabilities

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - akrherz
    - danclewley
    - gillins
    - ocefpaf
    - xylar
